summary.name: Store link bridge
summary.one_liner: A web page that turns a normal HTTPS link into a redirect to the Mac App Store or iOS App Store using a numeric app ID.
keywords: open app store from web link
use_cases: Share a clickable link to a Mac or iOS app in a GitHub README
Redirect web visitors into the App Store from a plain HTTPS URL
Link to an app from documentation where deep links do not render
Open a specific app listing by its numeric App Store ID
summary.what_it_does: The page takes a numeric app id passed as a query parameter and converts a normal https:// page into a deep link for the Mac App Store or iOS App Store. The stated goal is that GitHub README previews keep a clickable entry point. Once the page loads, it jumps the visitor straight into the store. The page says it works with mac, ios, iphone, and ipad. It also lists a set of Mac and iOS apps from the same author, including Dock Lift, Zipora, Scap, and Keyzer. The page shows an error message if the app id is missing or invalid.
notable: Converts a normal HTTPS link into an App Store redirect using a numeric app id
Keeps clickable App Store entry points in GitHub README previews
Lists the author's Mac and iOS apps as examples
caveats: Requires a numeric app id query parameter; the page errors without a valid one
Pricing and license are not stated on the page
